mentions.name: Stackwise
mentions.description: A biohacking platform for finding, creating, and sharing wellness protocols (e.g. sleep improvement, longevity protocols), rating supplements, tracking self-experiments, exploring a knowledge database of supplements and peptides with side effects and benefits, and comparing companies to find the cheapest blood tests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://stackwise.bio -- a biohackers playground
- find, create and share wellness protocols (improve sleep, brian johnson longevity protocol, ultimate mitochondria boost, etc)

- rating of all supplements

- track experiments you're running on yourself

- knowledge database of all supplements and peptides (side effects, benefits, etc)

- way to find the cheapest blood tests by comparing different companies
